summary.text: Cameron Reny is a Democratic state senator and educator who has represented Maine Senate District 13 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Reny's career experience includes working as an educator and a school counselor.
Reny assumed office in the Maine State Senate on December 6, 2022, succeeding Chloe Maxmin.
For 2025 and 2026 Reny was assigned to the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee and the Marine Resources Committee, and chaired the Marine Resources Committee in 2023 and 2024.
Reny advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
